<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($location) {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · MY REVIEWS · Client script

     Filter, sort, paginate, open. All of it over the set the
     server already sent — a reviewer's own assignments are tens
     of rows, not thousands, so a round trip per keystroke would
     buy nothing and cost the responsiveness.

     Nothing writes to window.location or calls window.open.
     $location.search moves between portal pages without a
     navigation sink.
     ========================================================= */

  var c = this;

  c.query   = '';
  c.status  = 'all';
  c.program = '';
  c.bucket  = 'all';
  c.sort    = 'due';
  c.page    = 1;

  var SIZE = c.data.pageSize || 15;


  /* =====================================================
     FACETS
     ===================================================== */

  function tally(tone) {
    var all = c.data.reviews || [];
    if (tone === 'all')  return all.length;
    if (tone === 'turn') return all.filter(function(r) { return r.myTurn && r.open; }).length;
    return all.filter(function(r) { return r.tone === tone; }).length;
  }

  c.filters = [
    { key: 'all',     label: 'Everything',  count: function() { return tally('all'); } },
    /* not a status but the question a reviewer actually asks
       first, so it sits with the statuses rather than in a
       separate control */
    { key: 'turn',    label: 'Your turn',   count: function() { return tally('turn'); } },
    { key: 'waiting', label: 'Not started', count: function() { return tally('waiting'); } },
    { key: 'open',    label: 'In progress', count: function() { return tally('open'); } },
    { key: 'done',    label: 'Completed',   count: function() { return tally('done'); } },
    { key: 'flag',    label: 'Escalated',   count: function() { return tally('flag'); } },
    { key: 'stood',   label: 'Declined',    count: function() { return tally('stood'); } }
  ];

  c.buckets = [
    { key: 'all',   label: 'Any deadline' },
    { key: 'late',  label: 'Past the deadline' },
    { key: 'week',  label: 'Within a week' },
    { key: 'later', label: 'Later than a week' },
    { key: 'none',  label: 'No deadline or settled' }
  ];

  c.sorts = [
    { key: 'due',       label: 'Deadline, soonest first' },
    { key: 'dueLast',   label: 'Deadline, latest first' },
    { key: 'scoreHigh', label: 'Score, highest first' },
    { key: 'scoreLow',  label: 'Score, lowest first' },
    { key: 'changed',   label: 'Recently changed' },
    { key: 'applicant', label: 'Applicant, A to Z' },
    { key: 'program',   label: 'Program, A to Z' }
  ];


  /* =====================================================
     MATCHING

     Cached. This is read by the template, the pager and the
     range text, so without a cache Angular re-filters and
     re-sorts on every digest and hands ng-repeat a fresh array
     reference each time, which stops the list settling.
     ===================================================== */

  var key  = null;
  var list = [];

  function lower(v) { return (v || '').toLowerCase(); }

  function order(k) {

    if (k === 'dueLast')   return function(a, b) { return b.deadlineSort - a.deadlineSort; };
    if (k === 'scoreHigh') return function(a, b) { return b.scoreSort - a.scoreSort; };

    if (k === 'scoreLow') {
      /* unscored rows sort last on ascending too. No score is
         an absence, not a low score, and putting them first
         would bury every real low score. */
      return function(a, b) {
        if (a.scoreSort < 0 && b.scoreSort < 0) return 0;
        if (a.scoreSort < 0) return 1;
        if (b.scoreSort < 0) return -1;
        return a.scoreSort - b.scoreSort;
      };
    }

    if (k === 'changed') {
      return function(a, b) {
        return a.updatedSort < b.updatedSort ? 1 : (a.updatedSort > b.updatedSort ? -1 : 0);
      };
    }

    if (k === 'applicant') return function(a, b) { return lower(a.applicant) < lower(b.applicant) ? -1 : 1; };
    if (k === 'program')   return function(a, b) { return lower(a.program) < lower(b.program) ? -1 : 1; };

    return function(a, b) { return a.deadlineSort - b.deadlineSort; };
  }

  c.matches = function() {

    var all = c.data.reviews || [];
    var k = [all.length, c.status, c.program, c.bucket, c.sort, lower(c.query)].join('|');

    if (k === key) return list;

    var out = all;

    if (c.status === 'turn') {
      out = out.filter(function(r) { return r.myTurn && r.open; });
    } else if (c.status !== 'all') {
      out = out.filter(function(r) { return r.tone === c.status; });
    }

    if (c.program) out = out.filter(function(r) { return r.program_id === c.program; });
    if (c.bucket !== 'all') out = out.filter(function(r) { return r.bucket === c.bucket; });

    var q = (c.query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) {
      /* the searchable blob is assembled server-side, so this
         is one indexOf per row rather than six joins per
         keystroke */
      out = out.filter(function(r) { return r.search.indexOf(q) > -1; });
    }

    /* slice before sort: sort mutates, and the array is the one
       the server sent. Sorting it in place would leave the
       unfiltered set permanently reordered. */
    out = out.slice().sort(order(c.sort));

    key  = k;
    list = out;
    return out;
  };

  c.dirty = function() {
    return !!(c.query || c.program || c.status !== 'all' ||
              c.bucket !== 'all' || c.sort !== 'due');
  };

  c.summary = function() {
    var all = c.data.reviews || [];
    if (!c.data.hasGroups) return 'No review group';
    if (!all.length) return 'Nothing assigned yet';

    var turn = tally('turn');
    var late = c.data.counts ? c.data.counts.late : 0;

    var s = all.length + (all.length === 1 ? ' review' : ' reviews') +
            ', ' + turn + ' waiting on your group';
    if (late) s += ', ' + late + ' past the deadline';
    return s;
  };


  /* =====================================================
     PAGING
     ===================================================== */

  var pk = null;
  var pl = [];

  c.pageCount = function() {
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(c.matches().length / SIZE));
  };

  c.rows = function() {
    var all = c.matches();
    var k = key + '|' + c.page;
    if (k === pk) return pl;
    pl = all.slice((c.page - 1) * SIZE, (c.page - 1) * SIZE + SIZE);
    pk = k;
    return pl;
  };

  /* a window of page numbers rather than all of them: thirty
     rows is two pages and fits, three hundred is twenty buttons
     and does not */
  c.pageList = function() {

    var total = c.pageCount();
    var out   = [];

    if (total <= 7) {
      for (var i = 1; i <= total; i++) out.push(i);
      return out;
    }

    out.push(1);
    var from = Math.max(2, c.page - 1);
    var to   = Math.min(total - 1, c.page + 1);
    if (from > 2) out.push('…');
    for (var p = from; p <= to; p++) out.push(p);
    if (to < total - 1) out.push('…');
    out.push(total);
    return out;
  };

  c.go = function(p) {
    if (p === '…') return;
    if (p < 1 || p > c.pageCount() || p === c.page) return;
    c.page = p;
  };

  c.rangeText = function() {
    var n = c.matches().length;
    if (!n) return '';
    var from = (c.page - 1) * SIZE + 1;
    return 'Showing ' + from + ' to ' + Math.min(n, c.page * SIZE) + ' of ' + n;
  };


  /* =====================================================
     CHANGES

     Any change to what is matched goes back to page one.
     Staying on page four of a result set that now has one page
     shows an empty list.
     ===================================================== */

  c.onChange = function() {
    key = null;
    pk  = null;
    c.page = 1;
  };

  /* sorting is the exception: it changes the order, not the
     set, so the reader stays where they are */
  c.onSort = function() {
    key = null;
    pk  = null;
  };

  c.setStatus = function(k) {
    if (c.status === k) return;
    c.status = k;
    c.onChange();
  };

  c.clearSearch = function() {
    c.query = '';
    c.onChange();
  };

  c.reset = function() {
    c.query   = '';
    c.status  = 'all';
    c.program = '';
    c.bucket  = 'all';
    c.sort    = 'due';
    c.onChange();
  };


  /* =====================================================
     OPENING

     The whole row is the target, so it takes a keyboard too. A
     div with a click handler and no key handler is a control
     half the people on the page cannot use.
     ===================================================== */

  c.open = function(r) {
    if (!r || !r.sys_id) return;
    $location.search({
      id    : c.data.detailPage || 'review_proposal_detail_page',
      sys_id: r.sys_id
    });
  };

  c.onKey = function(e, r) {
    if (!e) return;
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ' || e.keyCode === 13 || e.keyCode === 32) {
      e.preventDefault();
      c.open(r);
    }
  };
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================================
   GATENOW · MY REVIEWS
   Service Portal widget · CSS / SCSS

   Selectors are written out in full. The Service Portal Sass
   compiler does not support parent selector concatenation.

   Set in the same language as the proposal page this list
   leads into: hairlines carry the structure, cards are used
   only where something genuinely is a separate object, labels
   are sentence case, and colour appears in three places — the
   score band, the review state, and the one blue used for
   anything clickable.

   THE ROW

   Five columns, and the one that matters most is the third:
   whose turn is it. A reviewer scanning this list is not
   asking "what state is this in" so much as "is this mine to
   do". So the row says "Your turn" or "With Panel B" in plain
   words, and a row that is somebody else's is set back a shade
   rather than shouting at the same volume.

   TYPE
     title     24  700  -0.022em
     row ref   15  600  tabular
     row value 15  400
     label     14  400  sentence case, never capitals
     meta      13  400
   ========================================================= */

/* ---------- typeface ---------- */

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_regular.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_medium.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_semibold.woff2") format("woff2");
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "Outfit";
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url("/x_enno_gatenow_outfit_bold.woff2") format("woff2");
}


/* ---------- palette ----------
   The same six values and three signals as the proposal page,
   so a reviewer moving from a list into a proposal stays in
   one product.
   ------------------------------------------------------- */

$ink:   #0a2540;
$ink-2: #3a4a60;
$ink-3: #6b7a90;
$ink-4: #98a2b3;

$rule:   #e4e9f0;
$rule-2: #f0f3f8;
$wash:   #f7f9fc;
$paper:  #ffffff;
$ground: #f4f6fb;

$blue:    #1560e0;
$blue-dk: #0f4cbb;
$blue-1:  #eef4fe;

$high: #1f7a5c;
$mid:  #9a6b18;
$low:  #ab3243;

$ui:    "Outfit", "Segoe UI", Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
$serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Charter, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;

$ease: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);

/* =========================================================
   FRAME
   ========================================================= */

.panel,
.panel-body,
.sp-widget {
  overflow: visible !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.gn-shell {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: $ground;
}

/* min-width: 0 is load-bearing. Without it a flex child
   refuses to shrink below its own content width and slides
   under the rail instead of narrowing. */
.rq {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: $paper;
  font-family: $ui;
  color: $ink;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.rq *,
.rq *::before,
.rq *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.rq-stale {
  padding: 13px 28px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f0e0c0;
  background: #fdf6e9;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: #7d5713;
}


/* =========================================================
   BAR
   ========================================================= */

.rq-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 18px 28px;
  padding: 26px 28px 20px;
}

.rq-bar__lead { min-width: 0; }

.rq .rq-bar__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.022em;
  color: $ink;
}

/* the subtitle is a sentence about this reviewer's actual
   load, not a description of the page. "12 reviews, 3 waiting
   on your group" is worth reading; "All your assigned reviews"
   is not. */
.rq .rq-bar__sub {
  margin: 7px 0 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: $ink-3;
}

.rq-bar__tools {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rq-find {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  width: 320px;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
}

.rq-find input {
  width: 100%;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 34px 0 14px;
  border: 1px solid $rule;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: $paper;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: $ink;
  transition: border-color 0.2s $ease, box-shadow 0.2s $ease;
}

.rq-find input:focus {
  outline: 0;
  border-color: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px $blue-1;
}

.rq-find input::placeholder { color: $ink-4; }

.rq-find__x {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  color: $ink-4;
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s $ease;
}

.rq-find__x:hover { color: $ink; }

.rq-pick {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}

.rq-pick__l {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: $ink-4;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* a native select with no custom arrow. A bespoke dropdown has
   to reimplement keyboard handling, typeahead and the mobile
   picker, and does none of them as well as the browser. */
.rq-pick select {
  height: 38px;
  max-width: 230px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border: 1px solid $rule;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: $paper;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: $ink;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.2s $ease, box-shadow 0.2s $ease;
}

.rq-pick select:focus {
  outline: 0;
  border-color: rgba(21, 96, 224, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px $blue-1;
}


/* =========================================================
   FILTERS
   ========================================================= */

.rq-filters {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px 28px;
  padding: 0 28px 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $rule;
}

.rq-chips {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* words with a count, not filled pills. Seven filled pills in
   a row is seven things competing to be pressed. */
.rq-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 7px 11px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: $ink-3;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.18s $ease, color 0.18s $ease;
}

.rq-chip:hover {
  background: $wash;
  color: $ink;
}

.rq-chip.is-on {
  background: $ink;
  color: $paper;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.rq-chip__n {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-chip.is-on .rq-chip__n { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.64); }

.rq-more {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rq-reset {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: $blue-dk;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.rq-reset:hover { text-decoration: underline; }


/* =========================================================
   THE LIST

   Rows divided by hairlines, not floated as cards. Fifteen
   cards with fifteen shadows is fifteen objects; fifteen rows
   in a ruled list is one list.
   ========================================================= */

.rq-head,
.rq-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr) 190px 116px 140px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 0 28px;
}

.rq-head {
  padding-top: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $rule;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-row {
  padding-top: 15px;
  padding-bottom: 15px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $rule-2;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.16s $ease;
}

.rq-row:hover { background: $wash; }

.rq-row:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $blue;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

/* a row held by another group is set back rather than hidden.
   Readable, and plainly not the reader's move. */
.rq-row.is-theirs { background: #fcfdfe; }

.rq-row.is-theirs .rq-num,
.rq-row.is-theirs .rq-prog { color: $ink-2; }

/* late is carried by the deadline and a hairline at the edge,
   not by tinting the whole row. A list where four rows are
   pink stops being a list. */
.rq-row.is-late { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 $low; }

.rq-cell { min-width: 0; }

.rq-num {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.008em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink;
}

.rq-who {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 3px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: $ink-3;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* said rather than left blank, so nobody wonders whether it
   failed to load */
.rq-who--none,
.rq-prog--none {
  font-style: italic;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-prog {
  display: block;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: $ink;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.rq-org {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 3px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: $ink-4;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.rq-state {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: $ink-2;
}

.rq-state::before {
  content: "";
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
}

.rq-state--waiting { color: $mid; }
.rq-state--open    { color: $blue-dk; }
.rq-state--done    { color: $high; }
.rq-state--flag    { color: $low; }
.rq-state--stood   { color: $ink-4; }

/* whose move it is, in plain words. The third column is the
   one a reviewer scans first, so it answers the question they
   are actually asking. */
.rq-turn {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: $blue-dk;
}

.rq-turn--other {
  font-weight: 400;
  color: $ink-4;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.rq-score {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 3px;
}

.rq-score__n {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.014em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink;
}

/* the denominator, always. A bare 7 invites the question seven
   out of what. */
.rq-score__d {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-score--none {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-style: italic;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-due {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink-2;
}

.rq-due--late { color: $low; font-weight: 500; }
.rq-due--soon { color: $mid; font-weight: 500; }
.rq-due--ok   { color: $ink-2; }
.rq-due--none { color: $ink-4; font-style: italic; }


/* =========================================================
   PAGER
   ========================================================= */

.rq-pager {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px 24px;
  padding: 20px 28px 40px;
}

.rq .rq-pager__at {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink-4;
}

.rq-pager__go {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.rq-pg,
.rq-step {
  height: 34px;
  min-width: 34px;
  padding: 0 11px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: $ink-2;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.18s $ease, color 0.18s $ease;
}

.rq-pg:hover,
.rq-step:hover {
  background: $wash;
  color: $ink;
}

.rq-pg.is-on {
  background: $ink;
  color: $paper;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.rq-pg.is-gap {
  min-width: 20px;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: $ink-4;
  cursor: default;
}

.rq-pg:disabled,
.rq-step:disabled {
  opacity: 0.35;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: default;
}


/* =========================================================
   EMPTY

   An empty screen is a place to say what happens next, not a
   place for a shrug and an icon.
   ========================================================= */

.rq-empty {
  max-width: 52ch;
  padding: 72px 28px;
}

.rq .rq-empty__h {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.018em;
  color: $ink;
}

.rq .rq-empty__p {
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  font-family: $serif;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: #253449;
}

.rq-btn {
  height: 36px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border: 1px solid $rule;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: $paper;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: $ink-2;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.2s $ease, color 0.2s $ease;
}

.rq-btn:hover {
  border-color: $ink-4;
  color: $ink;
}

.rq-btn:focus-visible,
.rq-chip:focus-visible,
.rq-pg:focus-visible,
.rq-step:focus-visible,
.rq-reset:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid $blue;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   MOTION

   One fade at load and nothing else that moves on its own.
   The transitions above answer a hover, a focus or a press,
   which is the only motion a list has any use for.
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {

  @keyframes rqIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to   { opacity: 1; }
  }

  .rq-list { animation: rqIn 0.3s $ease; }
}


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 1200px) {

  .rq-head,
  .rq-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) 168px 100px 120px;
    gap: 18px;
    padding-left: 22px;
    padding-right: 22px;
  }

  .rq-bar,
  .rq-filters,
  .rq-pager,
  .rq-empty {
    padding-left: 22px;
    padding-right: 22px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 960px) {

  /* the header row goes first. It is a convenience at full
     width and a lie at reduced width, because the columns it
     labels no longer line up beneath it. */
  .rq-head { display: none; }

  .rq-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 140px;
    gap: 10px 20px;
    padding-top: 18px;
    padding-bottom: 18px;
  }

  /* reference and program take the wide side, status spans,
     score and deadline pair off on the last line */
  .rq-cell--ref   { grid-column: 1 / 2; }
  .rq-cell--prog  { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .rq-cell--state { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .rq-cell--score { grid-column: 1 / 2; }

  .rq-cell--due { text-align: right; }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {

  .rq-bar,
  .rq-filters,
  .rq-pager,
  .rq-empty,
  .rq-row {
    padding-left: 16px;
    padding-right: 16px;
  }

  .rq .rq-bar__title { font-size: 21px; }

  .rq-bar__tools { width: 100%; }

  .rq-find { width: 100%; }

  .rq-pick { width: 100%; }

  .rq-pick select {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: none;
  }

  .rq-chips {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .rq-chip { flex-shrink: 0; }

  .rq-more {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .rq-row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .rq-cell--due { text-align: left; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .rq,
  .rq * {
    transition: none;
    animation: none;
  }
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>review_proposals</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>Review Proposals</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles>x_enno_gatenow.grant_review_user</roles><script><![CDATA[(function () {

  /* =========================================================
     GATENOW · MY REVIEWS
     Service Portal widget · Server script

     Every review assigned to any of the reviewer's groups,
     settled or not, with the facets needed to cut it down.

     ── WHO SEES WHAT ─────────────────────────────────────────

     A review is assigned to one or more groups through the
     reviewer field, and one of them holds it at a time through
     review_group. Two different questions:

       reviewer     membership of any of these means you can
                    SEE the review
       review_group membership of this one means it is your
                    turn to act

     The query is on reviewer, and the turn is worked out per
     row. Querying review_group alone, as an earlier version
     did, hides a proposal from the other assigned groups until
     it reaches them — which is the opposite of what a queue is
     for.
     ========================================================= */

  var REVIEW    = 'x_enno_gatenow_grant_review';
  var PROGRAM   = 'x_enno_gatenow_grant_program';
  var APPLICANT = 'x_enno_gatenow_service_applicants';

  var me = gs.getUserID();

  data.shape   = 'reviewqueue-v2';
  data.reviews = [];

  if (typeof input === 'undefined' || input === null) input = {};

  function opt(name, fallback) {
    var v = options[name];
    return (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') ? fallback : v.toString();
  }

  data.detailPage = opt('detail_page', 'review_proposal_detail_page');
  data.pageSize   = parseInt(opt('page_size', '15'), 10) || 15;
  data.rail       = $sp.getWidget(opt('rail_widget', 'gatenow_reviewer_rail'));


  /* ============================================================
     HELPERS
     ============================================================ */

  var MONTHS = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun',
                'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

  function fmtDate(raw) {
    if (!raw || raw === 'null') return '';
    var d = String(raw).split(' ')[0].split('-');
    if (d.length !== 3) return String(raw).split(' ')[0];
    return parseInt(d[2], 10) + ' ' + MONTHS[parseInt(d[1], 10) - 1] + ' ' + d[0];
  }

  var now = new GlideDateTime();

  function daysFromNow(raw) {
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      var g = new GlideDateTime(String(raw).length === 10 ? raw + ' 00:00:00' : raw);
      return Math.round((g.getNumericValue() - now.getNumericValue()) / 86400000);
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }

  function r1(n) { return Math.round(n * 10) / 10; }


  /* ============================================================
     WHO IS ASKING
     ============================================================ */

  var groups = [];

  try {
    var gm = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user_grmember');
    gm.addQuery('user', me);
    gm.query();
    while (gm.next()) groups.push(gm.getValue('group'));
  } catch (e) {
    gs.warn('[MyReviews] group membership unreadable: ' + e.message);
  }

  data.hasGroups = groups.length > 0;

  function mine(sysId) {
    return !!sysId && groups.indexOf('' + sysId) !== -1;
  }


  /* ============================================================
     STATUS

     The five values on the form's choice list. Four tones plus
     one alarm: a tone names a kind of state, the status label
     carries which particular one it is.
     ============================================================ */

  var TONES = {
    'Review pending'      : 'waiting',
    'Review in progress'  : 'open',
    'Review completed'    : 'done',
    'Declined by Reviewer': 'stood',
    'Escalated'           : 'flag'
  };

  function toneOf(s) { return TONES[s] || 'waiting'; }

  function isOpen(s) {
    return s !== 'Review completed' && s !== 'Declined by Reviewer';
  }


  /* ============================================================
     THE ROWS
     ============================================================ */

  var counts = { all: 0, waiting: 0, open: 0, done: 0, stood: 0, flag: 0,
                 turn: 0, late: 0 };

  var programCache   = {};
  var applicantCache = {};
  var programSeen    = {};

  function program(sysId) {
    if (!sysId) return null;
    if (programCache[sysId] !== undefined) return programCache[sysId];
    var out = null;
    try {
      var pg = new GlideRecordSecure(PROGRAM);
      if (pg.get(sysId)) {
        out = {
          name    : pg.getDisplayValue('program_name') || '',
          number  : pg.getValue('number') || '',
          category: pg.getDisplayValue('category') || ''
        };
      }
    } catch (e) { /* leave null; the row says so */ }
    programCache[sysId] = out;
    return out;
  }

  function applicant(sysId) {
    if (!sysId) return null;
    if (applicantCache[sysId] !== undefined) return applicantCache[sysId];
    var out = null;
    try {
      var ap = new GlideRecordSecure(APPLICANT);
      if (ap.get(sysId)) {
        out = {
          name  : ((ap.getValue('first_name') || '') + ' ' +
                   (ap.getValue('last_name') || '')).trim(),
          number: ap.getValue('number') || '',
          org   : ap.getValue('organization') || ''
        };
      }
    } catch (e) { /* as above */ }
    applicantCache[sysId] = out;
    return out;
  }

  if (groups.length) {

    var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(REVIEW);

    /* reviewer is a list of groups, so the match is CONTAINS
       per group, OR'd together. addOrCondition is called on the
       QueryCondition the first addQuery returned, which keeps
       the whole OR bracketed as one condition rather than
       leaking across the rest of the query. */
    var hasReviewer = false;
    try { hasReviewer = gr.isValidField('reviewer'); } catch (e) {}

    if (hasReviewer) {
      var qc = gr.addQuery('reviewer', 'CONTAINS', groups[0]);
      for (var q = 1; q < groups.length; q++) {
        qc.addOrCondition('reviewer', 'CONTAINS', groups[q]);
      }
    } else {
      gr.addQuery('review_group', 'IN', groups.join(','));
      gs.info('[MyReviews] no reviewer field, falling back to review_group');
    }

    gr.orderBy('review_deadline');
    gr.query();

    while (gr.next()) {

      var status = gr.getDisplayValue('status') || gs.getMessage('Unknown');
      var tone   = toneOf(status);
      var open   = isOpen(status);

      var holderId = gr.getValue('review_group');
      var myTurn   = mine(holderId);

      var dlRaw = gr.getValue('review_deadline') || '';
      var days  = daysFromNow(dlRaw);

      /* only work that is actually with one of my groups counts
         as late for me. A review sitting past its deadline in
         somebody else's queue is their problem, and marking it
         red here would be telling me to act on something I
         cannot act on. */
      var late = (open && myTurn && days !== null && days < 0);

      var bucket;
      if (!open || days === null) bucket = 'none';
      else if (days < 0)          bucket = 'late';
      else if (days <= 7)         bucket = 'week';
      else                        bucket = 'later';

      var due;
      if (!dlRaw)        due = { text: 'No deadline', tone: 'none' };
      else if (!open)    due = { text: fmtDate(dlRaw), tone: 'none' };
      else if (!myTurn)  due = { text: fmtDate(dlRaw), tone: 'none' };
      else if (days < 0) {
        var n = Math.abs(days);
        due = { text: n + (n === 1 ? ' day late' : ' days late'), tone: 'late' };
      }
      else if (days === 0) due = { text: 'Due today', tone: 'soon' };
      else if (days <= 7)  due = { text: days + (days === 1 ? ' day left' : ' days left'), tone: 'soon' };
      else                 due = { text: fmtDate(dlRaw), tone: 'ok' };

      var scoreRaw = gr.getValue('score');
      var score    = (scoreRaw === '' || scoreRaw === null) ? null : parseFloat(scoreRaw);
      if (score === null || isNaN(score)) score = null;

      var pgmId = gr.getValue('program');
      var pgm   = program(pgmId);
      var apl   = applicant(gr.getValue('applicant'));

      counts.all++;
      if (counts[tone] !== undefined) counts[tone]++;
      if (open && myTurn) counts.turn++;
      if (late) counts.late++;

      if (pgmId && pgm && !programSeen[pgmId]) {
        programSeen[pgmId] = { key: pgmId, label: pgm.name || pgm.number, count: 0 };
      }
      if (pgmId && programSeen[pgmId]) programSeen[pgmId].count++;

      var row = {
        sys_id: gr.getUniqueValue(),
        number: gr.getValue('number') || '',

        status: status,
        tone  : tone,
        open  : open,

        myTurn  : myTurn,
        holder  : gr.getDisplayValue('review_group') || '',

        applicant: apl ? apl.name : '',
        org      : apl ? apl.org : '',

        program_id: pgmId || '',
        program   : pgm ? pgm.name : '',
        category  : pgm ? pgm.category : '',

        deadline    : fmtDate(dlRaw),
        deadlineSort: days === null ? 999999 : days,
        dueText : due.text,
        dueTone : due.tone,
        bucket  : bucket,
        late    : late,

        score    : score,
        scoreText: score === null ? '' : r1(score) + '',
        scoreSort: score === null ? -1 : score,

        updatedSort: gr.getValue('sys_updated_on') || '',
        updated    : fmtDate(gr.getValue('sys_updated_on'))
      };

      row.search = (row.number + ' ' + row.applicant + ' ' + row.org + ' ' +
                    row.program + ' ' + row.status + ' ' + row.holder).toLowerCase();

      data.reviews.push(row);
    }
  }


  /* ============================================================
     FACETS

     Built from the rows rather than a choice table. A program
     the reviewer has no work for should not appear in their
     filter, and one that exists only in their data should.
     ============================================================ */

  var progList = [];
  for (var k in programSeen) {
    if (programSeen.hasOwnProperty(k)) progList.push(programSeen[k]);
  }
  progList.sort(function (a, b) {
    return (a.label || '').toLowerCase() < (b.label || '').toLowerCase() ? -1 : 1;
  });

  data.programs = progList;
  data.counts   = counts;

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>umar.farooq</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-15 10:38:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>5841bd5293974710d444c9b877373c1a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Review Proposals</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GateNow" source="x_enno_gatenow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="GateNow">eabeaf98eb033a10520dfbdffdc0cd51</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_5841bd5293974710d444c9b877373c1a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>umar.farooq</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-15 10:40:29</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<!-- =========================================================
     GATENOW · MY REVIEWS
     Service Portal widget · HTML template

     A work queue, set like the proposal page it leads into:
     hairlines instead of floating cards, sentence case instead
     of tracked-out capitals, one accent.

     The column the reader scans first is the one that says
     whether a row is theirs to act on. Everything else on the
     row is there to help them recognise it.
     ========================================================= -->

<div class="gn-shell">

  <sp-widget widget="data.rail"></sp-widget>

  <div class="rq">

    <!-- the four fields are one unit: paste three and the page
         renders an empty list with nothing to explain it -->
    <div class="rq-stale" ng-if="c.data.shape !== 'reviewqueue-v2'">
      The server script has not been updated. This page is running new markup
      against an older script, so the list has no data to work from.
    </div>


    <!-- ═══════════════ BAR ═══════════════ -->
    <header class="rq-bar">

      <div class="rq-bar__lead">
        <h1 class="rq-bar__title">My reviews</h1>
        <p class="rq-bar__sub">{{c.summary()}}</p>
      </div>

      <div class="rq-bar__tools" ng-if="c.data.reviews.length">

        <label class="rq-find">
          <input type="text" ng-model="c.query" ng-change="c.onChange()"
                 placeholder="Search by reference, applicant or program" />
          <button type="button" class="rq-find__x"
                  ng-if="c.query" ng-click="c.clearSearch()"
                  aria-label="Clear the search">×</button>
        </label>

        <label class="rq-pick">
          <span class="rq-pick__l">Sort</span>
          <select ng-model="c.sort" ng-change="c.onSort()">
            <option ng-repeat="s in c.sorts track by s.key" value="{{s.key}}">{{s.label}}</option>
          </select>
        </label>

      </div>

    </header>


    <!-- ═══════════════ FILTERS ═══════════════

         Status as a row of plain words, because status is the
         filter reached for constantly. Program and deadline as
         selects underneath, because they are not.
         ═══════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="rq-filters" ng-if="c.data.reviews.length">

      <nav class="rq-chips" aria-label="Filter by status">
        <button type="button" class="rq-chip"
                ng-repeat="f in c.filters track by f.key"
                ng-class="{'is-on': c.status === f.key}"
                ng-click="c.setStatus(f.key)">
          {{f.label}}<span class="rq-chip__n">{{f.count()}}</span>
        </button>
      </nav>

      <div class="rq-more">

        <label class="rq-pick" ng-if="c.data.programs.length > 1">
          <span class="rq-pick__l">Program</span>
          <select ng-model="c.program" ng-change="c.onChange()">
            <option value="">Every program</option>
            <option ng-repeat="p in c.data.programs track by p.key"
                    value="{{p.key}}">{{p.label}} ({{p.count}})</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <label class="rq-pick">
          <span class="rq-pick__l">Deadline</span>
          <select ng-model="c.bucket" ng-change="c.onChange()">
            <option ng-repeat="b in c.buckets track by b.key" value="{{b.key}}">{{b.label}}</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <button type="button" class="rq-reset" ng-if="c.dirty()" ng-click="c.reset()">
          Clear filters
        </button>

      </div>

    </div>


    <!-- ═══════════════ THE LIST ═══════════════ -->
    <div class="rq-list" ng-if="c.rows().length">

      <div class="rq-head" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>Reference</span>
        <span>Program</span>
        <span>Status</span>
        <span>Score</span>
        <span>Deadline</span>
      </div>

      <article class="rq-row"
               ng-repeat="r in c.rows() track by r.sys_id"
               ng-class="{'is-late': r.late, 'is-theirs': !r.myTurn && r.open}"
               ng-click="c.open(r)"
               ng-keydown="c.onKey($event, r)"
               tabindex="0" role="link">

        <div class="rq-cell rq-cell--ref">
          <span class="rq-num">{{r.number}}</span>
          <span class="rq-who" ng-if="r.applicant">{{r.applicant}}</span>
          <span class="rq-who rq-who--none" ng-if="!r.applicant">No applicant on record</span>
        </div>

        <div class="rq-cell rq-cell--prog">
          <span class="rq-prog" ng-if="r.program">{{r.program}}</span>
          <span class="rq-prog rq-prog--none" ng-if="!r.program">No program set</span>
          <span class="rq-org" ng-if="r.org">{{r.org}}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="rq-cell rq-cell--state">
          <span class="rq-state" ng-class="'rq-state--' + r.tone">{{r.status}}</span>
          <!-- the fact the whole row turns on: whose move is it -->
          <span class="rq-turn" ng-if="r.myTurn && r.open">Your turn</span>
          <span class="rq-turn rq-turn--other" ng-if="!r.myTurn && r.open">With {{r.holder}}</span>
        </div>

        <div class="rq-cell rq-cell--score">
          <span class="rq-score" ng-if="r.score !== null">
            <span class="rq-score__n">{{r.scoreText}}</span>
            <span class="rq-score__d">/10</span>
          </span>
          <span class="rq-score rq-score--none" ng-if="r.score === null">Not scored</span>
        </div>

        <div class="rq-cell rq-cell--due">
          <span class="rq-due" ng-class="'rq-due--' + r.dueTone">{{r.dueText}}</span>
        </div>

      </article>

    </div>


    <!-- ═══════════════ PAGER ═══════════════ -->
    <nav class="rq-pager" ng-if="c.pageCount() > 1">

      <p class="rq-pager__at">{{c.rangeText()}}</p>

      <div class="rq-pager__go">
        <button type="button" class="rq-step"
                ng-disabled="c.page === 1" ng-click="c.go(c.page - 1)">Previous</button>
        <button type="button" class="rq-pg"
                ng-repeat="p in c.pageList() track by $index"
                ng-class="{'is-on': p === c.page, 'is-gap': p === '…'}"
                ng-disabled="p === '…'"
                ng-click="c.go(p)">{{p}}</button>
        <button type="button" class="rq-step"
                ng-disabled="c.page === c.pageCount()" ng-click="c.go(c.page + 1)">Next</button>
      </div>

    </nav>


    <!-- ═══════════════ EMPTY ═══════════════

         An empty screen is a place to say what to do next, not
         a place for a shrug and an icon.
         ═══════════════════════════════════ -->

    <div class="rq-empty" ng-if="!c.data.hasGroups">
      <h2 class="rq-empty__h">You are not in a review group yet</h2>
      <p class="rq-empty__p">
        Reviews are assigned to groups rather than to people. Ask the program office
        to add you to the group that handles your area, and anything assigned to it
        will appear here.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="rq-empty" ng-if="c.data.hasGroups && !c.data.reviews.length">
      <h2 class="rq-empty__h">Nothing assigned to your groups</h2>
      <p class="rq-empty__p">
        When a proposal is sent to one of your groups it appears here, whether or not
        it is your group's turn to act on it.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="rq-empty" ng-if="c.data.reviews.length && !c.matches().length">
      <h2 class="rq-empty__h">Nothing matches those filters</h2>
      <p class="rq-empty__p">Widen one of them, or start again.</p>
      <button type="button" class="rq-btn" ng-click="c.reset()">Clear filters</button>
    </div>

  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
